F05.name: golden_cross
F05.formula: SMA20 > SMA60 and prior SMA20 <= prior SMA60

F12.name: bollinger_squeeze
F12.formula: BB20 width == min width over 125 sessions

F14.name: squeeze_breakout
F14.formula: F13 and F12 in prior 20 sessions

F20.name: spring_proxy
F20.formula: Low < prior Low20 min and Close > prior Low20 min

F21.name: three_session_2b_proxy
F21.formula: support=min Low[t-23:t-4]; min Low[t-3:t-1]<support; prior Close<=support<Close

F22.name: bullish_engulfing
F22.formula: prior bear; current bull; Open<=prior Close; Close>=prior Open; prior Close<prior SMA20

F23.name: piercing
F23.formula: prior bear; current bull; Open<prior Low; prior body midpoint<Close<prior Open; prior Close<prior SMA20

F24.name: bullish_harami
F24.formula: prior bear; current bull; Open>=prior Close; Close<=prior Open; prior Close<prior SMA20

F25.name: hammer
F25.formula: 0<body<=0.35*range; lower wick>=2*body; upper wick<=body; prior Close<prior SMA20

F29.name: macd_cross
F29.formula: MACD > signal EMA9 and prior MACD <= prior signal

F33.name: legacy_bottom_2b
F33.formula: Low < min prior 20 Low sets pending(level=prior min, expires=5); later non-new-low bar decrements expiry and fires if Close > level before removal
F33.version_notes: v1: detect_bottom_2b component only; new low overrides pending; no same-bar reclaim; gap resets history and pending; excludes calculate_signal warmup/entry gates

F34.name: legacy_ma_convergence
F34.formula: (max(SMA5, SMA10, SMA20) - min(SMA5, SMA10, SMA20)) / Close <= 0.02
F34.version_notes: v1: is_converged SMA component; 20 observations including current; gap resets history

F35.name: legacy_convergence_trend_ready
F35.version_notes: v1: convergence plus is_trend_ready SMA price comparison; 20 observations including current; excludes legacy caller's extra warmup and position gates

F36.name: rs20_top_quintile
F36.formula: contemporaneous eligible ret20 rank(pct=True, average ties) >= 0.8

F37.name: rs60_top_quintile
F37.formula: contemporaneous eligible ret60 rank(pct=True, average ties) >= 0.8
